title: Reconcile's observer loop is the suite's last unplaced fetch-spray
body:
internal/reconcile/reconcile_observer_test.go (TestReviewH0fAnOperatorObservingARunEndsNothing) still provokes its contention the way the two runstate tests did before tick 1qy: a goroutine loops `git fetch` + a full runstate Open/Fetch/Findings + `git log` for the whole length of a reconcile end-to-end run, paced only by time.Sleep(time.Millisecond) — effectively git-spawn-bound, an extra core of process spawns beside the suite's heaviest package, in the full suite CI and close-out pay for. Its assertions are 'at least once' vacuity guards, so its provocation is spray-and-hope, and under a fast-enough fixture it can fail on machine timing (the vacuity guards firing) — the cy2 shape this epic exists to remove. runstate now has the seam for placing this exactly (Store.contend, tick 1qy); reaching the reconciler's own store from the fixture is the plumbing a tick would have to work out. Out of tick 1qy's named scope (concurrent_fetch_test.go:69 and :168 only), so proposed rather than done.
evidence: internal/reconcile/reconcile_observer_test.go:61-104 (the loop, the 1ms sleep, the at-least-once guards at :119-129)
